newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up, 3rd mth holds firm above 1250.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up, 3rd mth holds firm above 1250.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended firmer, extending overnight gains despite some profit-taking at higher levels. Trading was cautious with players waiting for key March crop data next week and traders expect prices to move up if PORLA data is supportive. June futures may test 1,260 again and then 1,280 for resistance. Strong support is seen at 1,235.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Ended the week firmer in active trade.

At the close, the June futures contract was six ringgit higher at 1,256 ringgit ($501.59) a tonne. Traders said the market was generally cautious as players were reluctant to trade ahead of next week's data announcements.

Malaysia's Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) will release March crop data on Tuesday. Traders expect prices to drift narrowly early next week as players wait for PORLA export/stock/output data.
"If the PORLA data is supportive, the market may rise further and break the 1,280 ringgit level and then try to test the 1,280 ringgit level," a chartist said.
Next week's trend will also depend on a crop report from forecaster Ivan Wong on April 14, traders said. They expect the data to be little changed from his previous estimate.
He estimated palm oil stocks for end-March at 725,000 tonnes, exports at 560,000 tonnes, and March's output to rise by 32 percent to 663,000 tonnes in his previous report.

Physicals April (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,310 ringgit vs bids of 1,305 after trading at 1,305 and 1,307.50. April (central) saw offers at 1,295 vs bids 1,290 with earlier dones seen at 1,290 and 1,287.50. May (south) was offered at 1,305 vs bids at 1,300 with earlier dones at 1,300 and 1,302.50.
May (central) saw sellers at 1,290 and bids at 1,285.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $547.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May $545, June at $542.50 and July/Aug/Sept at $537.50. May was traded at $543.50.
Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $585, May at $582.50, June at $577.50 and July/Aug/Sept at $570. April was dealt at $585 and May at $580.
Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $440 and May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290. --Tan Lee Lee (603-230-7510) ($1 =2.5040 ringgit )
